Name: Sprinklers All Day
Author: Yadm
Description:
[heading][size=4]Sprinklers All Day[/size][/heading]
[line]
[size=4]A sprinkler fires every two hours when it has a dry tilled tile in reach. The 6:00 AM watering stays the same.[/size]


[color=#fafafa][size=4][youtube]SPTSRM_hnAE[/youtube][/size][/color]

[heading]More from Yadm[/heading]
[line]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54022]Hired Help[/url]. Hire a neighbor, pay them, and they walk the farm and do the chores. Choose from 12 neighbors and more than 50 jobs: water, hoe, plant, harvest, the greenhouse, animals, kegs, jars, casks, furnaces, forage, trees, and hay.

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53328]Easy Access Buttons[/url]. Inventory and chest buttons from other mods share one column.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53092]Guild Kill List[/url]. After floor 100 of the Mines, the monster eradication list is on your inventory.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53287]Perfection Shortcut[/url]. After Qi's Walnut Room unlocks, an inventory button opens the game's perfection tracker.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53144]Staircase Spacing[/url]. A staircase stays in your bag when another ladder is already nearby in the Mines or Skull Cavern.[/*]
[/list][line]

The hours are 8:00, 10:00, 12:00, 2:00, 4:00, 6:00, 8:00, 10:00, 12:00, and 2:00 AM. Empty hoed soil counts. A sprinkler whose tilled soil is already wet stays quiet.

The reach is that sprinkler's normal reach, including a pressure nozzle. The spray is the game's own spray. It plays when you are in that place. Soil in the greenhouse or on Ginger Island still gets watered while you are away.

Outdoors in the rain, these later passes stay quiet. The greenhouse still runs on a rainy day. Mr. Qi's order that turns sprinklers off still applies.

Garden pots and the pet bowl stay dry. A slime hutch trough still fills at the start of the day.

A crop planted after midnight is watered at 2:00 AM. If you sleep before then, it waits until the next morning.
[line]
One switch turns the later passes off. The morning watering stays.

[heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.14 or later[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 4.1.0 or later[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is optional[/*]
[/list]
[heading]Install[/heading]
[list]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Unzip this download into Stardew Valley/Mods, or install the zip with Vortex.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][line]
The mod folder should look like this.
[code]
Mods/SprinklersAllDay/
  SprinklersAllDay.dll
  manifest.json
  README.md
  i18n/default.json[/code]
[heading]Option[/heading]
[line]
[bold]Water through the day[/bold] starts on. With Generic Mod Config Menu, open Sprinklers All Day and uncheck it. The change applies on the next even hour. Or, after the first launch, edit Mods/SprinklersAllDay/config.json and set "Enabled" to false.
